ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of high-intensity white pixels (approx. 85%) across the central ventral surface with low-intensity black pixels (approx. 15%) concentrated at the trailing edges and isolated focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black perimeter banding along the entire trailing edge. Isolated dark circular spots (focal mottling) distributed across both lobes, with a notable high-contrast dark cluster on the lower-center of the right lobe near the water interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 45-55 degrees; base partially obscured by high-intensity water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with high pixel amplitude (5-15 pixels) along the lateral segments, significantly modulated by high-texture 3D protrusions from barnacle colonization on the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve transitioning from concave near the median notch to convex at the lateral terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular ring-like pixel clusters (dark outlines on white ground) visible on the upper-inner region of the right lobe. Dense high-contrast white/grey barnacle clusters on the far lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the central-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation (Coronula diadema) creating irregular, calcified protrusions on the distal edges of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: One prominent, isolated dark elliptical mark on the lower-right lobe near the water line, distinct from the smaller mottling patterns.
